c6ff47bb.text:
The word BETRAYER is crudely scratched over the finely etched epitaph that reads:

Yuriv lies here.
Father, Husband, $C.
Let his children bear witness to the fact that his dedication to the Light was unquestionable.
He would never ask anything of them that he himself would not do.
c6ff47bb.title: Yuriv's Tombstone

10378|4fa5b9c3.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|4fa5b9c3.text: Where can I send you today $c?

10378|5d1f9ab4.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|5d1f9ab4.text: Treat the wind rider well as it takes you to your destination.  May your ancestors watch over you $N.

10668|8ac74c94.name: Beaten Corpse
10668|8ac74c94.text:
The body is that of a female $r warrior.

It is clear that she died in battle, probably against the quilboar in the area.

10668|aa4f9f41.name: Beaten Corpse
10668|aa4f9f41.text:
You turn the body over and see the marks from blades and spells upon the deceased $r--her armor all but destroyed, her hair matted to her face.

Based on Mankrik's description of her, there is no doubt in your mind that this was his wife.

He will be upset by the news, but you are sure he should know the truth.

13417|1605f087.name: Sagorne Creststrider
13417|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

1518|173903a2.name: Apothecary Johaan
1518|173903a2.text: The Dark Lady has put forth the challenge.  It is up to us to meet it.

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1937|19122c56.name: Apothecary Renferrel
1937|19122c56.text: The Dark Lady has put the challenge forth. Now it is up to the Royal Apothecary Society to develop a new plague. We shall bring Arthas and his wretched army to their knees.

1952|7327dd7a.name: High Executor Hadrec
1952|7327dd7a.text: Hello, $C.  If you're here, then you must know that Silverpine is saturated with our enemies.  To survive, the Forsaken must drive them back!

2132|db927cdf.name: Carolai Anise
2132|db927cdf.text: Nice to see a friendly face. I don't get much chitchat from Apothecary Johaan unless he wants something. He's been out of the grave too long. Someday I'll be like that, I hear. Creepy. Maybe by then I won't care.

2226|dd7de3ae.name: Karos Razok
2226|dd7de3ae.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

246152|8754b3a4.name: Shari Stilwell
246152|8754b3a4.text: The light is a beacon that shines for all. What can I do for you, $c?

246389|8e0ab317.name: Hilda the Breaker
246389|8e0ab317.text:
Why do they call me "The Breaker"?

Trust me, you don't want to know.

246389|b676ae27.name: Hilda the Breaker
246389|b676ae27.text:
A little bit of a lot of things. Mostly I take the soft and weak and reshape them into hardened fighters once again.

It's a tough world out there, and even our own people mistrust us. We need to be tough and self-reliant if we are to fit into this "Horde" with the rest of our people.

246393|4b78c376.name: Jorin Croge
246393|4b78c376.text: There are many things lurking out there in the dark and the light is needed now more than ever. If only these poor souls could see that just because our world has changed doesn't mean we have to be the monsters that the living think we are.

246394|63539e70.name: Ander Solliden
246394|63539e70.text: In my previous life, I lived nearby here. I still wander the fields of my childhood farmstead occasionally. It fills me with sadness to see those I knew and loved, shambling around as mindless thralls. It pains me, but it's that very pain that gives me strength and purpose.

246394|82d61c10.name: Ander Solliden
246394|82d61c10.text:
Mostly the usual. Murloc attacks, the occasional Scarlet Crusade skirmish. There are even some paladins that can't quite adjust to life as a Forsaken. Far too often we have to put those down that turn their blades upon their brothers. 

By far the worst is when some mindless thrall wanders too close. I can kill murlocs all day, but some of the scourge I've had to destroy were former friends of mine. Some were even family members.

I'd rather it be me who puts them down than some random adventurer, but it still stings.

257655|9f0fb116.name: Deathguard Billmuth
257655|9f0fb116.text: <Deathguard Billmuth absentmindedly fidgets as he looks around nervously. He is clearly very uncomfortable being here.>

265944|0c543544.name: William Pickman
265944|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

267008|b4ea9d59.name: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered
267008|b4ea9d59.text: They named it Bandarion Keep. I wonder what Garek would make of that?

267009|6f316d7a.name: Hadric Harlson
267009|6f316d7a.text: Be careful, $c. There are cultists nearby.

272526|bf500b92.name: Glix Xizzix
272526|bf500b92.text:
Yes, I am the renowned trader who magnanimously fed the uh, starving... children...? ...of the Undercity during the recent war with the Scourge. Yes, I am the visionary businessgob and logistical genius who single-handedly armed the resistance and allowed our Dark Lady to found her nation of smelly corpses... um, I mean, "Forsaken."

Yep, I'm him. Glix Xizzix. I'd be happy to sign an autograph. For a small fee, of course.

What am I doing here running a barbershop, you ask? Well I got one word for you, bub--diversification. You've got to keep your revenue streams diversified!

276067|2af62916.name: Angus Hammerhand
276067|2af62916.text:
It's my job to get the Paladins of Bandarion Keep set up with proper arms and armor. It's not much, but it's honest work.

I've got a thing or two for sale as well, should you need gear.

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3320|2f8d506f.name: Soran
3320|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3320|6b36598f.name: Soran
3320|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3320|ae78a458.name: Soran
3320|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

3344|1605f087.name: Kardris Dreamseeker
3344|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

3365|0443423e.name: Karolek
3365|0443423e.text: The twists and turns of Orgrimmar are designed to thwart invaders. Can you imagine how quickly one of those puny gnomes would get lost in here? Ha! If it was lucky, I'd track it down and keep it as a pet.

3373|1355f2b7.name: Arnok
3373|1355f2b7.text: I am an $r of medicine, $r. If you have come here to learn, I shall do my best to teach.

3387|da8a5dad.name: Jorn Skyseer
3387|da8a5dad.text: Although we call this land the Barrens, to one who knows where to look this place teems with life.

3389|5612724d.name: Regthar Deathgate
3389|5612724d.text: We have our duties, $c.  Duties to the Horde.

3391|8f749700.name: Gazlowe
3391|8f749700.text: Thrall paid me and my boys well for helping out with the construction of Orgrimmar, so I decided to set up a port here. We do most of our business through Booty Bay and Baron Revilgaz.

3429|4e7d06f7.name: Thork
3429|4e7d06f7.text:
Welcome to the Crossroads, $c. My name is Thork--I lead the defenses here in the name of the Warchief.

Please, feel free to make yourself at home. As long as you mind your business, no one should have any problem with you taking up some space.

There are many threats to our safety here. If you've already become familiar with the lay of the land, speak to the others here--perhaps they have tasks for you to do.

3430|0e16a4d2.name: Mangletooth
3430|0e16a4d2.text:
You! $R! Come here. <snort>

Time is short, and my end <snort> is near. Mangletooth shall win; you will see. <snort>

My capture can still aid <snort> my people. The Razormane tribe is more powerful than the Bristlebacks!

The Horde looks to find out who leads the raids on their people. You <snort> shall aid Mangletooth in return for the information only I know. Mangletooth can help you! <snort> But you must help Mangletooth.

3432|c1a3099b.name: Mankrik
3432|c1a3099b.text:
I came to the Crossroads from the south seeking help, $c, but I find only cowards who turn their backs on me--even the mighty Thork insults me so. He is a good leader, but his dismissal of my plea causes me greater anger.

He claims my rage makes me hasty--that it clouds my judgement--but I will not rest until I have vengeance!

3433|ac5dfa0b.name: Tatternack Steelforge
3433|ac5dfa0b.text:
The Warchief has instructed me to study all kinds of weapons and armor. He has sent me here to the hub of both the tauren and $r cultures in the Barrens to meet as many travelers as possible, and to learn about the cultures of the Barrens.

He feels there's something to be learned from even the most pathetic of cultures... like the quilboar or centaur.

3442|ef9d74c5.name: Sputtervalve
3442|ef9d74c5.text: Director Riddlevox put me in charge of the Union's shredder development program. Few months on the job and I'm already in hot water! I could use your help, $N!

3446|36457281.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
3446|36457281.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the $r I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

3448|dcea3712.name: Tonga Runetotem
3448|dcea3712.text: The times we live in are as fickle as the shifting winds, $c.  It is important to remember what is true and lasting in this world, and to preserve that.  Everything else is a waste.

3453|48c11c0f.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
3453|48c11c0f.text: Something I can help you with, $N? There's a shipment I've got to see to otherwise.

3489|68d65f37.name: Zargh
3489|68d65f37.text: Have a look at my meats, friend.  You won't want to go out into the Barrens without a good stock of provisions.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

3682|960c6ca2.name: Vrang Wildgore
3682|960c6ca2.text: Are you in need of a weapon, traveler? You'll not find a finer blade anywhere, I assure you.

4312|c5ceacbe.name: Tharm
4312|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4552|0c543544.name: Eunice Burch
4552|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

4556|3dfe0528.name: Gordon Wendham
4556|3dfe0528.text: Greetings, and welcome.  I am not very good at smiling, but trust me; I am happy to serve you.

4605|3a5f002e.name: Basil Frye
4605|3a5f002e.text: You are not trying to kill the anvil with your hammer, you are trying to create a weapon to kill your foes with. Let me show you what you are doing wrong.

4773|0450da3d.name: Velma Warnam
4773|0450da3d.text: I can teach you the finer points of Skeletal Horse Riding, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!

4949|9255c79c.name: Thrall
4949|9255c79c.text:
It would be wise to explain to you the depths at which our enemies will go to to hide themselves under our noses.

Know this first and foremost: our enemy is the Shadow Council. No matter what task I give you, or who I ask you to act against, know that one simple fact.

Many cults exist within the Council, but only to hide its actions against the foolish.

Groups like the Burning Blade, the Argus Wake, and the Searing Blade are all tools of the Council. Consider them one and the same.

5688|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Renee
5688|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

5759|a28d29e1.name: Nurse Neela
5759|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

5811|e65e27ca.name: Kamari
5811|e65e27ca.text: I have nothing more to teach you. Talk to Karolek if you wish to further your leatherworking skills.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6739|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Bates
6739|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

6741|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

6929|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Gryshka
6929|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

822-accept.name: Brewmaster Drohn
822-accept.text:
Good stuff, that stormstout, huh?

I have another recipe that I learned from Chen. Would you be interested? It won't take long to make, and it might be useful if you plan on adventuring some more.

Bring me 5 lightning glands from any stormhide, 1 thunderhawk saliva gland from greater thunderhawks, and a kodo liver from any of the Barrens' kodos.

Like I said, this stuff has kick; it's the trogg brew that I mentioned to you before.
822-accept.title: Chen's Empty Keg

94427-complete.name: Tanis Alderwood
94427-complete.text: You... you are a $c? Please, do not hurt me. I-I know I'm not supposed to be panhandling. I have no quarrel with you or your order. Leave me be, I beg you!
94427-complete.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94438-accept.name: Deathguard Billmuth
94438-accept.text:
Falgan and I were sent on a mission to scout out scarlet activity in Venomweb Vale. We managed to sneak close enough to one of their camps to hear about new orders involving an attack on Brill. Before we could decide what to do next, I stepped on a twig and the noise alerted them to us.

Falgan yelled at me to run, so I ran. By the time I realized he wasn't with me, I was halfway to Brill. That brave idiot probably stayed behind to hold them off for me.

Please, find my friend and help him if you can.
94438-accept.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94438-complete.name: Deathguard Falgan
94438-complete.text:
I'm... back? And saved by a $c no less? I see you carry a Symbol of Life. I've not seen one of those since... well, since before the war when Lordaeron was a very different place. I can only assume you are here to help. Billmuth and I were sent here to scout out the scarlet activity here, and we found out that they are planning some kind of attack.

If you would be willing to help more, there may yet be more that you can do to help the Forsaken.
94438-complete.title: A Lesson in Divinity

95507-progress.name: Vrang Wildgore
95507-progress.text: <Vrang grunts at you as you approach.>
95507-progress.title: Vrang's Game

95803-complete.name: Lady Sylvanas Windrunner
95803-complete.text:
I don't doubt Danitha's sincerity and desire to earn a place for your kind amongst the Forsaken. However, I suspect that this isn't the last time we'll see one of your brothers and sisters go mad and turn the light against their own people.

There may come a time when I decide that tolerating your misbegotten order is no longer in the best interests of the Forsaken. I suggest you continue to serve your people diligently.

We will be watching.
95803-complete.title: A Token of Good Faith
